description: Create and manage Softr databases, tables, fields and records, and search table data.

softr_new_database_trigger.description: Runs for each new database in Softr. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. It can watch up to 4,000.

softr_new_record_trigger.description: Runs for each new record in Softr. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. It can watch up to 4,000.

softr_new_table_trigger.description: Runs for each new table in Softr. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. It can watch up to 4,000.

softr_record_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each record changed in Softr. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. It can watch up to 4,000.
